senses.gloss: that which is dedicated to a sacred purpose, esp. sacred or Temple property.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 66b:10">Yeb. 66ᵇ</cite> bot., a. fr. <he>ה׳ וכ׳</he> a pledged animal which the debtor dedicates as a sacrifice &c., v. <cite ref="Q01502"><he>פָּקַע</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:3">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> <he>ה׳ דמים</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 8:7">Arakh. VIII, 7</cite> <he>ה׳ עילוי</he> dedication of the value of an object; opp. <he>ה׳ מזבח</he> dedication for the altar (allowing no redemption).

<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 7:1">Ib. VII, 1</cite> <he>אין מחשבין חדשים לה׳</he> months are not counted for redeeming dedicated property, i.e. fractions of a year count for a year in favor of the treasury.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 2b:2">Kidd. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>דאסר לה אכ״ע כה׳</he> because (by betrothing her to himself) he makes her forbidden to all other men like sacred property (v. <cite ref="S00192"><he>קָדַשׁ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Taanit 24a:9">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>הרי הן ה׳ עליך וכ׳</he> they shall be to thee sacred property (like charity funds); a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Arakhin 2a:31">Arakh. 2ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Temurah 2a:19">Tem. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>תחלת ה׳</he> a preliminary act of dedication, <he>סוף ה׳</he> the final dedication (laying hands on the animal’s head prior to sacrificing it).

<cite ref="Temurah 9b:26">Ib. 9ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 54b:11">B. Mets. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ ראשון</he> the original dedication, <he>ה׳ שני</he> the substitution (for an animal which became defective); a. fr.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>; a. fr.—

senses.gloss: laws concerning dedication. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 24; ib.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:9">Ḥag. I, 9</cite> (ed. Zuck. <he>והקרקעות</he>, corr. acc.); a. e.
